[[File:Remduba_system_convoy_AoRCR.png|thumb|right|250px|An Imperial convoy travels through the [[Remduba system]]]]
A '''convoy''' was a group of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or vehicles traveling together for mutual support. Often used by traders and other transports, they allowed for better defense of vulnerable ships.
